note: Editor toolbar buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for file and edit actions (e.g., New, Open, Save, Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Find, Replace)
Editor toolbar toggle buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for view and mode toggles (e.g., Show Line Numbers, Show Right Margin, Fullscreen)
Editor toolbar checkboxes -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for view options (e.g., Word Wrap, Highlight Current Line)
Editor toolbar radio buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for view modes (e.g., Normal, Wrap, Indent)
Editor toolbar labels -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for status indicators (e.g., Encoding, Line/Column, Zoom)
Editor status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for document status (e.g., Ln, Col, Encoding, EOL)
